title: Mastercard Debuts Agent Pay for 'Agentic Commerce Future'
quote: The launch of Mastercard Agent Pay marks our initial steps in redefining commerce in the AI era, including new merchant interfaces to distinguish trusted agents from bad actors. — Jorn Lambert, Chief Product Officer (announcement dated Apr 29, 2025; named partners include Microsoft, IBM, Braintree, Checkout.com).

title: Mastercard Unveils New Tools and Collaborations to Power Smarter, Safer Agentic Commerce
quote: Sept 10, 2025: introduces Agent Toolkit (Model Context Protocol server on Mastercard Developers), Agent Sign-Up, Insight Tokens, Agentic Consulting Services and expansion of Agent Pay to all U.S. Mastercard cardholders before the holiday season; partners include Stripe, Google, Ant International's Antom, PayOS, Citi, U.S. Bank, SAP Concur, FIDO Alliance.

title: Mastercard/developers-agent-toolkit
quote: The Mastercard Developers Agent Toolkit allows popular agent frameworks (currently Model Context Protocol - MCP) to integrate with Mastercard Developers for service discovery and integration guides. Node 18+, TypeScript/JavaScript, MIT licence; `npx -y @mastercard/developers-mcp`.

title: developers-agent-toolkit / modelcontextprotocol / README
quote: MCP server uses stdio transport; tools include get-services-list, get-documentation, get-documentation-section-content, get-documentation-page, get-api-operation-list, get-api-operation-details, get-oauth10a-integration-guide, get-oauth20-integration-guide, get-openfinance-integration-guide; Claude Desktop and VS Code integration examples provided.

title: Supporting additional payment methods for agentic commerce
quote: Agentic network tokens are network-issued, secure digital credentials that allow authorized AI agents to initiate payments on a customer's behalf without exposing underlying card details. When a customer authorizes an agent to make purchases, Stripe provisions an agentic network token from Mastercard or Visa scoped to the customer's intent and shares it with the agent.

title: Announcing Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
quote: AP2 (announced Sept 17, 2025) is an open, payment-agnostic protocol developed with 60+ organizations including Adyen, American Express, Ant International, Coinbase, Etsy, Intuit, JCB, Mastercard, Mysten Labs, PayPal, Revolut, Salesforce, ServiceNow, UnionPay International, Worldpay. Trust is built on Intent, Cart and Payment Mandates.

title: google-agentic-commerce/AP2
quote: Building a Secure and Interoperable Future for AI-Driven Payments. Apache-2.0 licensed. Code samples include human-present card scenarios under code/samples/python/scenarios/a2a/human-present/cards/.

title: Mastercard on Agentic Payments: How AI Agents, Tokenization, and Authentication Will Redefine Digital Commerce
quote: Pablo Fourez, Mastercard Chief Digital Officer: 'Know Your Agent' is a new layer of identity verification that helps differentiate trusted AI agents from malicious bots; Mastercard extends tokenization and biometric passkey authentication to power safe AI-led transactions, with intent and consent data bound to payment tokens for traceability.

title: Mastercard x Checkout: A discussion on agentic commerce
quote: In order to get access to tokens, agents need to be registered through a KYC-style process to ensure legitimate parties are onboarded. User intent data (e.g. 'Adidas shoes, size 10, €80') accompanies the token through the transaction; consumers authenticate with biometrics, passkeys, or 2FA.

title: Visa, Mastercard race to agentic AI commerce
quote: Both Visa and Mastercard announced agentic payment initiatives in April 2025. Both rely on tokenization for authentication, fraud prevention, and dispute resolution, though neither specified consumer approval mechanisms for bot-initiated purchases.

title: Santander and Mastercard complete Europe's first live end-to-end payment executed by an AI agent
Mastercard and PayPal Join Forces To Accelerate Secure Global Agentic Commerce
quote: Mastercard Agent Pay will be integrated into PayPal's wallet so AI agents can complete transactions on behalf of PayPal users; PayPal will pilot the Mastercard Agent Pay Acceptance Framework and co-develop testing with agents and merchants.

title: Enabling AI agents to buy securely and seamlessly — Visa Intelligent Commerce
quote: Visa Intelligent Commerce: Visa Agent APIs enable agents to transact on behalf of consumers and businesses; tokenized payments and authentication APIs protect transactions while reducing friction; ensure only approved AI agents transact.

title: Stripe powers Instant Checkout in ChatGPT and releases Agentic Commerce Protocol codeveloped with OpenAI
quote: Stripe issues a Shared Payment Token (SPT) scoped to a specific merchant and cart total so applications like ChatGPT can initiate a payment without exposing the buyer's payment credentials; ACP is open-source, Apache-2.0, codeveloped with OpenAI.

title: agentic-commerce-protocol — open standard maintained by OpenAI and Stripe
quote: The Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) is an interaction model and open standard for connecting buyers, their AI agents, and businesses to complete purchases seamlessly. Maintained by OpenAI and Stripe; Apache-2.0.

title: Strong Customer Authentication — implementation guide
quote: PSD2 in the EU/EEA/UK requires SCA for most cardholder-initiated electronic payments. Out-of-scope categories include Merchant-Initiated Transactions (MIT). The European Commission has issued proposals for a Payment Services Directive 3 / Payment Services Regulation that may redefine these boundaries.

title: Mastercard: 'Agentic commerce is here'
quote: CEO Michael Miebach (Q3 2025 earnings, Oct 30, 2025): 'Our first agentic transaction took place on our network this quarter.' U.S. Bank and Citibank cardholders can now use Agent Pay; expansion to remaining U.S. issuers in November and global rollout in early 2026.

title: FIDO Alliance to Develop Standards for Trusted AI Agent Interactions
quote: FIDO Alliance forms Agentic Authentication and Payments Technical Working Groups; Payments TWG is chaired by Mastercard and Visa members; Mastercard contributes its Verifiable Intent framework, co-developed with Google to work with AP2.

title: Mastercard x Checkout: agent token scope and merchant binding (excerpt)
quote: Mastercard is driving industry standards around MCP servers to expose APIs to agents, allowing merchants to make product data discoverable so agents can factor specific attributes (size, fare class, refund conditions) into decisions.

title: Agentic Commerce: Threats and Risks
quote: Visa saw a 25% increase in malicious bot-initiated transactions over the past 6 months, with the US experiencing a 40% increase a share expected to grow as agentic commerce scales … more than 450% increase in dark web community posts in underground channels mentioning 'AI Agent' over the past six months compared to the prior six-month period.
